name: Black Knights (Wilderness)
accessNote: Level 33 Wilderness Black Knights spawn south of the Bandit Camp (Lava Maze area, ~level 33) with a further cluster north-east of the Bone Yard. Family-tuned copy of bandit-camp-wilderness (CT-L rule 2): the black knights occupy a distinct adjacent spot. Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated, so conservative defaults are used. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness risk gear.
